messages:
Elaine H.: Heads-up — Aurigma started POC prep. Security flagged a few enterprise auth items: SSO (Okta SAML), SCIM group push for RBAC, domain ownership proofing, and they want a Dedicated pricing option for a 3-month POC. Can we confirm blockers and next steps?
Beth S.: Thanks Elaine — can you share their expected user counts and whether they want group->role mapping via SCIM or SAML assertions? Need that to size Dedicated and the quote.
Samir R.: We support Okta SAML + SCIM v2.0. Main engineering question: do they require SCIM-driven group->role mapping (preferred) or do they want to rely on SAML group claims?
Elaine H.: Security insists groups map to RBAC in our console. They want SCIM group push as canonical source. Numbers: ~120 users, ~10 admins, POC 3 months, peak ~40 concurrent inference requests.
Jen D.: For POC we'll need IdP metadata and a SCIM admin token. Note on SCIM rate limits: default is 60 req/min; for Dedicated POC we can increase. Example SCIM PATCH we asked them to try: ```PATCH /scim/v2/Groups/{id} {"members":[{"value":"00u1a...","display":"alice@aurigma.com"}],"schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:Group"]}```
Samir R.: SAML attributes we'll consume: ```<Attribute Name=\"email\" /><Attribute Name=\"groups\" /><Attribute Name=\"urn:redwood:role\" />``` If they want automated admin provisioning, SCIM must present group with display name `redwood-admins`.
Beth S.: On pricing: for a 3-month Dedicated POC we usually quote a reserved slot + overage. I'll draft a POC quote; Elaine can you confirm procurement contact and timeline?
Elaine H.: Billing owner is Tom (tom@aurigma.com). Procurement timeline ~2 weeks; legal is reviewing our security pack. I uploaded SOC2 and network diagrams to the drive (link shared in DM).
Jen D.: I'll schedule POC kickoff for Fri 10am PT and send a short onboarding checklist: 1) share IdP metadata XML, 2) add our ACS URL and EntityID, 3) create SCIM admin token and give scope, 4) DNS TXT for domain proofing.
Samir R.: Implementation note — we can do live RBAC mapping: map Okta groups -> Redwood roles. If they need domain locking (prevent other tenants claiming domain) we require DNS TXT verification and will set domain-ownership flag. During POC we can enable a canary fallback to hosted model for traffic spikes.
Beth S.: I'll include an increased SCIM throughput in the quote for the POC and call out the dedicated capacity option. @Elaine H. can you follow up with Tom & Legal after kickoff? :thumbsup:
